newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Clinic, Netcare say merger talks advanced.
newsitem.headline: Clinic, Netcare say merger talks advanced.

text.p: South African healthcare firms Clinic Holdings Ltd and Network Healthcare Holdings Ltd on Monday said talks were advanced which could see the change of control of Clinics to Netcare.

"Negotiations have reached an advanced stage for the conclusion of certain transactions which inter alia include the acquisition by Clinics of hospitals of Netcare, the recapitalisation of Clinics and the change of control of Clinics to Netcare," the firm said in a brief statement.
They added that the deal is likely to be sealed soon and a further more detailed announcement will be made then.
Both firm firm urged shareholders to continue to use caution when dealing in their shares.
Speculation of a merger has been a driving force behind both firms' stocks this month.

Clinic said on June 5 that its controlling shareholders were still in talks which could have an impact on its share price and in February Netcare also warned its shareholders that it was in talks that could have an impact upon its share price.

Netcare only listed on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange last December and in May posted a maiden set of results that came in ahead of forecasts. It posted earnings per share of 3.8 cents and a dividend of one cent.
